Maya: Quick heads-up — Crestline is pushing to shorten renewal to 6mo and wants invoice split across two entities. Procurement asked for vendor code + SOC2 report before they will sign. They also want KMS key integration confirmed before e-sign. 
Jordan: Noted. Did they confirm seat counts? they keep shifting between 120/135. I asked to lock by EOD.
Maya: Seat locked at 135 for now. Renewal pricing needs to be recalculated (pro-rate + mid-term true-up). Risk: Finance may delay until PO + vendor code present. :warning:
Sam: If they need vendor code we can provision it but legal needs a signed SOW + DPA. We can accept a provisional PO for first invoice (net30) while KMS is completed. 
Amy: Agree re: SOW. Also need the KMS HSM attestation added to the contract appendix if they insist on key custody. Small redline, quick turnaround. 
Jordan: Can we do provisional PO + signature routing via DocuSign conditional on KMS completion? Client wants digital asap.
Maya: Procurement won't approve without audit evidence. Suggested path: 1) Customer sends provisional PO (covers onboarding fees) 2) We send amended SOW with KMS appendix 3) Customer signs Docusign for SOW, SRE runs KMS onboarding in parallel. 
OpsBot: Reminder — onboarding task created: ONB-7894. KMS runbook assigned to eng-infra. ETA 3 business days. :white_check_mark:
Sam: I'll issue vendor code once Amy signs off on the contract appendix. If onboarding slips >7 days we push first invoice hold and escalate to AE.
Amy: I'll draft the appendix now, share for quick review. 
Maya: Thanks — tagging @Jordan to confirm customer will send provisional PO today. Jordan?
Jordan: Got verbal ok, chasing procurement now. Will update here by 17:00 PST. :eyes:
Maya: Great — flagging as medium renewal risk until PO + appendix are in. I'll update PAS dashboard.
